description_en: Queries the cluster backup sets of an ApsaraDB for MongoDB sharded cluster instance with cloud disks
description_zh: 查询云数据库 MongoDB 版云盘版分片集群的集群备份集列表
name: DescribeClusterBackups

parameters.help_en: The page number. Default value: 1. Valid values: positive integers
parameters.help_zh: 分页页号。默认值为1，取值范围为正整数
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

30 (default)
50
100
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值：

30（默认值）
50
100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC. This parameter does not take effect when BackupId is specified
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 当传入BackupId时，此参数无效
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC. This parameter does not take effect when BackupId is specified
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，必须晚于查询开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 当传入BackupId时，此参数无效
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query the information about child nodes in the cluster backup. Valid values:
true: returns only the basic information about the cluster backup and does not return the backup information about all child nodes.
false (default): returns the backup information about all child nodes
parameters.help_zh:
是否查询集群备份下的子节点信息。取值说明：
true：只返回集群备份基本信息，不返回全量的子节点的备份信息。
false（默认 ）：返回全量的子节点的备份信息
parameters.name: is_only_get_cluster_back_up

parameters.help_en:
The region where the instance resides.

This parameter is required when you query the backup sets of a released instance.
This parameter is required when you query cross-region backups
parameters.help_zh:
实例所在地域。

查询已释放实例的备份集列表式，该参数必填。
查询异地备份时，该参数必填
parameters.name: src_region

parameters.help_en:
The region where the cross-region backup resides.

This parameter is required when you query cross-region backups
parameters.help_zh:
异地备份所在地域。

查询异地备份时，该参数必填
parameters.name: dest_region

ClusterBackups.description_en: The cluster backup sets. A cluster backup set contains the backup sets of all nodes
ClusterBackups.description_zh: 集群备份集列表，一个集群备份里面包含各个节点的备份集

items.description_en: The cluster backup sets. A cluster backup set contains the backup sets of all nodes
items.description_zh: 集群备份集列表，一个集群备份里面包含各个节点的备份集

AttachLogStatus.description_en:
The status of the attached log backup. Valid values:
Init: The attached log backup is being initialized.
No_Need: No attached log backup is required.
Running: The attached log backup is in progress.
Ready: The attached log backup is complete.
Failed: The attached log backup fails.

When the ClusterBackupStatus parameter is set to OK, it only indicates that the full backup phase is successful. For cluster instances with log backup enabled, the attached log backup must be complete to perform point-in-time recovery or achieve consistent recovery
AttachLogStatus.description_zh:
备份的状态，取值如下：
Init：初始化。
No_Need：无附加日志备份。
Running：附加日志备份中。
Ready：附加日志备份完成。
Failed：附加日志备份失败。

当ClusterBackupStatus参数（集群备份集的状态）的值为OK时，仅表示全量备份阶段执行成功了，对于开启了日志备份的集群实例，想要使用按时间点恢复或满足一致性恢复的效果时，需要附加日志备份完成

BackupExpireTime.description_en: The expire time of the backup. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC. A value of "9999-01-01T00:00:00Z" indicates long-term retention (LTR).
BackupExpireTime.description_zh: 备份过期时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 "9999-01-01T00:00:00Z"表示长期保留。>

BackupIntranetDownloadURL.description_en: The internal endpoint used to download the backup file. If the backup file cannot be downloaded, a null value is returned
